'''Suzanne Louise Weekes''' is the chief executive officer of the [[Society for Industrial and Applied Mathematics]].<ref>{{cite journal|url=https://awm-math.org/wp-content/uploads/2020/10/AWM-News-NovDec-2020-PRINT.pdf|title=Suzanne L. Weekes Named SIAM Executive Director|journal=AWM Newsletter|page=15|date=November–December 2020}}</ref> She is also Professor of [[Mathematical sciences|Mathematical Sciences]] at [[Worcester Polytechnic Institute]] (WPI). She is a co-founder of the [[Mathematical Sciences Research Institute]] Undergraduate Program.<ref name=mgp/>

==Education==
Weekes is [[Caribbean-American]], and was born and raised in [[Trinidad and Tobago]].<ref name=mgp>{{cite web|url=http://mathematicallygiftedandblack.com/honorees/suzanne-l-weekes/|title=Suzanne L. Weekes|work=Mathematically Gifted & Black: Black History Month 2017 Honoree|accessdate=2018-12-03}}</ref> She graduated in 1989 from [[Indiana University Bloomington]] with a major in [[mathematics]] and a minor in [[computer science]].<ref name=mgp/> She went on to get an MS in [[applied mathematics]] in 1990 and a PhD in Mathematics and Scientific Computing in 1995 at the [[University of Michigan]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://users.wpi.edu/~sweekes/|title=Suzanne L. Weekes @ WPI|website=users.wpi.edu|access-date=2017-04-08}}</ref>

==Career==
Weekes is the co-director of the Preparation for Industrial Careers in Mathematical Sciences, which helps faculty in the U.S. engage their students with Industrial math research. She is a professor of mathematical sciences at Worcester Polytechnic Institute as well as a cofounder of MSRI-UP, a research experience for undergraduates that aims to increase under represented groups in math programs by providing them with research opportunities.<ref name=mgp/> In July 2019, she became Interim Associate Dean of Undergraduate Studies at WPI.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.wpi.edu/news/suzanne-weekes-named-interim-associate-dean-undergraduate-studies|title=Weekes Aims to Expand Undergraduate Research Opportunities|website=WPI|language=en|access-date=2020-02-01}}</ref> In December 2019, she was elected to the executive committee of the [[Association for Women in Mathematics]] as an at large member.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://awm-math.org/awm-election-results/|title=AWM Election Results|date=2019-12-24|website=Association for Women in Mathematics (AWM)|language=en-US|access-date=2020-02-01}}</ref>

==Awards and recognition==
In 2015, Weekes received the Denise Nicoletti Trustees' Award for Service to Community.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.wpi.edu/news/convocation2015|title=Awards for Excellence in Teaching, Research, Advising, and Community Service Presented at Honors Convocation {{!}} News {{!}} WPI|website=www.wpi.edu|language=en|access-date=2017-04-08}}</ref> Weekes was recognized by [[Mathematically Gifted & Black]] as a Black History Month 2017 Honoree.<ref name=mgp/> She received the 2019 [[M. Gweneth Humphreys Award]] for mentorship from the Association for Women in Mathematics.<ref>{{cite web |title=2019 M. Gweneth Humphreys Award Winner |url=https://awm-math.org/awards/humphreys-award/humphreys-award-2019/ |accessdate=24 October 2018 |website=Association for Women in Mathematics}}</ref> She won one of the [[Deborah and Franklin Haimo Awards for Distinguished College or University Teaching of Mathematics]] from the [[Mathematical Association of America]] in 2020.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.maa.org/programs-and-communities/member-communities/maa-awards/teaching-awards/haimo-award-distinguished-teaching|title=Deborah and Franklin Tepper Haimo Award {{!}} Mathematical Association of America|website=www.maa.org|access-date=2020-02-01}}</ref> She was honored as the 2022 [[AWM/MAA Falconer Lecturer|AWM-MAA Etta Zuber Falconer Lecturer]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=SIAM Executive Director Suzanne L. Weekes Named 2022 AWM-MAA Etta Zuber Falconer Lecturer |url=https://sinews.siam.org/Details-Page/siam-executive-director-suzanne-l-weekes-named-2022-awm-maa-etta-zuber-falconer-lecturer |access-date=2022-05-28 |website=SIAM News |language=en-US}}</ref> Weekes was selected a [[Fellow]] of the [[Association for Women in Mathematics]] in the class of 2024 "for her consistent and outstanding support for broadening the participation of women and girls as well as others that are underrepresented in mathematics; for her award-winning teaching and mentoring; and for her vision and success in co-creating and co-directing innovative programs that have improved and diversified the mathematics community."<ref name="Association for Women in Mathematics (AWM) b931">{{cite web | title=2024 AWM Fellows | website=Association for Women in Mathematics (AWM) | url=https://awm-math.org/awards/awm-fellows/2024-awm-fellows/ | access-date=2023-10-28}}</ref>
